market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chongqing be 30°C on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: Chongqing early May average highs ~25.9°C, range 24-30°C with rainy/drizzle conditions on May 5 noted. The 30°C bucket sits at the upper end of typical range and rain tends to suppress highs. Possible but not central case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether rain dominates May 5 (suppressing highs) or sun breaks lift them.
